name: Boards
description: Azure DevOps boards per project, laid out like Azure DevOps: each project follows the team boards you pick from your organisations, one tab per board. Open, edit, drag between columns, create and delete cards right here, and Jig can read and update them from your chats. Uses your own az login.

tools.description: List the Azure DevOps boards the chat's Jig project follows (name, team, organisation/project). Use a board's name as `board` in the other boards tools; without it they use the first board.
The cards on an Azure DevOps board of this project, column by column: id, type, title, state, who has it. Filter by column or by text in the id, title or assignee.

query.description: Text to find in id, title or assignee

tools.description: One Azure DevOps work item with everything its form shows: description and acceptance criteria as plain text (images as [image: name]; descriptionHtml/acceptanceHtml too when they hold images), other rich-text fields (repro steps, system info…), state, column, tags, priority, story points, more fields (reason, severity, effort, dates, custom fields), links (parent, children, related… with their titles and states, and hyperlinks), attachments, development (branches, commits, pull requests, builds), comments, and the states its type can be in.

Change an Azure DevOps work item: title, description, acceptance criteria, state, move it to a board column (its state follows the column), assignee, tags, priority, story points, area, iteration, or add a comment. Only the given fields change. Keep the board up to date as work progresses in the chat.

description.description: Plain text; replaces the whole description, its images and formatting too. To keep them, use descriptionHtml

descriptionHtml.description: HTML; replaces the description. Start from the card's descriptionHtml to keep its images (their attachment URLs)

acceptance.description: Plain text; replaces the acceptance criteria

acceptanceHtml.description: HTML; replaces the acceptance criteria (keeps images like descriptionHtml)

state.description: One of the states its type can be in

column.description: A column of the board, to move the card

assignedTo.description: Email or display name; empty to unassign

tools.description: Create a work item on an Azure DevOps board of this project with everything filled in at once: title, description, acceptance criteria, column or state, assignee, tags, priority, story points, area and iteration (default: the team's area and default iteration, so it shows on the board), and a parent item.

type.description: Work item type: User Story, Bug, Task, Feature…

descriptionHtml.description: HTML instead of the plain-text description

acceptance.description: Plain text acceptance criteria (types that have them)

column.description: The board column to put it in (its state follows the column)

state.description: One of the states its type can be in

iteration.description: Iteration path (default: the team's default iteration)

tools.description: Delete an Azure DevOps work item (it goes to the project's recycle bin, where it can be restored). Only when the user asks for it.
